title: Microsoft Edge: allow Microsoft 365 authentication pop-ups in work profiles
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's documentation supports the default behaviour, policy paths, registry settings and platform restrictions, and the roadmap facts match the record. The Graph description needs only a small clarification naming the request-body property used to update a setting.
